description: This file implements functions for managing USB interfaces and endpoints, specifically for Android Debug Bridge (ADB) on Windows. It includes functions for enumerating interfaces, creating and opening interfaces and endpoints, querying their properties, performing asynchronous and synchronous read/write operations, and handle management. It appears to be part of a DLL providing a WinUSB-based ADB API implementation.

classes.name: AdbInterfaceEnumObject
classes.description: Represents an enumerator for USB interfaces matching specific criteria.

classes.name: AdbInterfaceObject
classes.description: Represents a USB interface instance and provides methods to access its properties and perform operations.

classes.name: AdbEndpointObject
classes.description: Represents a USB endpoint and provides methods for I/O operations.

classes.name: AdbIOCompletion
classes.description: Handles overlapped I/O operations for endpoints.
